correction: LLD §13 Decision 12 mandated UCSingleCatalog for the Spark write path; combination of UC OSS 0.4.0 + spark-expectations + local FS is unworkable (saveAsTable not supported, EXTERNAL paths need cloud creds, MANAGED is experimental).
pattern: For local-FS educational dev stacks the LLD must NOT mandate UCSingleCatalog as the Spark write path. Either (a) recommend Spark's built-in Hive metastore (Derby) with DeltaCatalog and keep UC as a read-only UI demo, or (b) defer UC integration to a separate chapter that assumes cloud storage + creds.

correction: LLD §5.1 / DMS treated Bronze columns as defined upstream by DMS — but DMS is a logical model focused on Silver/Gold and does not enumerate landing-zone source columns. Empty 'columns: []' stubs blocked the runner's no-inference contract.
pattern: Bronze contract columns come from the source system (DuckDB DESCRIBE / CSV header). DMS owns Silver and Gold. The LLD must make this split explicit and instruct create-scaffold to populate Bronze contracts via a sync-from-source script.

correction: LLD §4.1 specified concurrency=16 for Bronze TaskGroup. SE writes a shared stats table; concurrent CREATE attempts race and the losers orphan Delta files.
pattern: LLD §4.1 must default to max_active_tasks=1 and catchup=False in dev. Concurrency raises only allowed after the first successful run seeds the shared SE stats/error tables.

correction: LLD §6.1 DEV memory was 2g driver / 2g executor; in an 8GB Docker pool shared with UC + Marquez + Postgres + Airflow this OOM-killed the Spark driver.
pattern: LLD §6.1 DEV defaults should be 1g driver / 1g executor for local docker-compose stacks. Memory sizing must call out the host RAM assumption explicitly.

correction: LLD §9.1 left runtime path resolution implicit; spark-submit CWD inside the worker is not the project root, so YAML relative paths broke.
pattern: LLD §9.1 must mandate an explicit project-root env var (e.g. PATIENT360_PROJECT_ROOT) that all runtime path resolution anchors against. docker-compose env block exports it.

correction: LLD §4.2 generated reconciliation_bronze as a PythonOperator that boots PySpark in-process — fails on Airflow 3.x (_start_update_server is_unix_domain_sock TypeError).
pattern: Under Airflow 3.x every task that touches Spark MUST be a SparkSubmitOperator (own JVM). PythonOperator with an in-process SparkSession is forbidden in §4.2 of the LLD.

correction: LLD §8.6.1 expected reconciliation to match on Airflow ts_nodash as the SE meta_dq_run_id; spark-expectations generates its own run_id internally and exposes no external override.
pattern: LLD §8.6.1 SE-RUN-EVIDENCE invariant must filter on meta_dq_run_date (= Airflow ds), not meta_dq_run_id. The audit anchor is 'SE ran today', not 'SE ran for this Airflow run instance'.

correction: User directed: revoke Decision 12 (UCSingleCatalog as Spark catalog) — replace with Delta+Hive(Derby) for local-FS dev. UC OSS retained for UI demo only.
pattern: When the LLD reverses a prior Decision N, the matching validator rule (here check_bronze_uc_wiring) must be patched to honor an explicit 'Revoked'/'Reverted' Status marker — otherwise the hook blocks every subsequent edit on the same file.

correction: User directed: §2.3 Bronze contract columns come from the SOURCE (DuckDB DESCRIBE / CSV header), not the DMS. DMS owns Silver/Gold only.
pattern: Bronze layer column contracts must be sourced from the source system itself, not from the DMS. The DMS owns Silver/Gold contracts. Bronze is a permissive landing zone — schema-drift handling belongs in Silver.

correction: User directed: any task touching Spark MUST be SparkSubmitOperator in Airflow 3.x. In-process PySpark from a PythonOperator hangs.
pattern: In any LLD targeting Airflow 3.x with embedded Spark, §4.2 must state explicitly that every Spark-touching task uses SparkSubmitOperator. PythonOperator + pyspark.sql.SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate() collides on classloaders inside the Airflow worker JVM.

correction: User directed: §8.6.1 SE evidence query filters on meta_dq_run_date only — SE owns meta_dq_run_id and rejects override from ts_nodash.
pattern: spark-expectations generates its own meta_dq_run_id internally and does NOT accept an override from Airflow ts_nodash. Any SE evidence/reconciliation query must key on meta_dq_run_date (the ds) only.

correction: User directed: DEV Spark memory dropped from 2g/2g to 1g/1g due to OOM in 8GB Docker with UC + Marquez + Postgres + Airflow co-resident.
pattern: For chapter-5's single-laptop educational deployment, DEV Spark driver and executor memory defaults are 1g/1g (not 2g/2g). The compose stack co-residency must be accounted for in §6.1 sizing.

correction: User directed: §9.1 must declare PATIENT360_PROJECT_ROOT as the env var that anchors every relative path; docker-compose must export it.
pattern: Every chapter-5 LLD must declare a single PROJECT_ROOT-style env var that anchors all runtime relative paths (configs, dq_rules, warehouse, dead-letter). Hardcoded /opt/airflow/* literals and bare relative paths must both be rejected.
